claim_one_line: FRAME C'S DOWN COUPLING IS THE SYMBOL OF ONE COVARIANT OPERATOR ON FAMILIES TIMES THE WEIL SPACE; IT SPLITS 3 + 2; ITS HYPERCHARGE COMPONENT IS A COVARIANT SUM OVER THE 24 POINTS; THE UP SECTOR IS OBSTRUCTED AT LEVEL 5 (PROVED to 1e-13 at two base points and their T and S images, both readings; data-free; P-866's C1): point by point Y(g tau, w) = c phi(g, w) U_L Y(tau, w g) U_R^dagger with unitaries the same at all 24 points; for down phi = zeta^(-a^2) under T and zeta^(2ab) under S, for up 25th roots; with the forced phase table zeta^(-ab), O(tau) = sum of zeta^(-ab) Y(tau, w) (x) D(w) obeys O(g tau) = c (U_L x rho(g)) O(tau) (U_R x rho(g))^dagger with B1951's Weil representation; O commutes with the centre's parity, so it is a block over the 3 plus a block over the 2, whose family Gramians are covariant and differ; their sum is 5 times the plain Gramian (Parseval); the sum over the 24 points with the phase table is covariant under T and S and is the operator's component along hypercharge, 6Y = -(1/2) the sum of the 24 operators D(v); frame outputs at two bulk points printed and not compared. 0 of 19.
